candidates.statement: Checkout 502s (~2s each) stem from order's calls to payment timing out: traces show POST payment ReadTimeout transport errors and POST order ReadTimeout, while inventory/redis reservations succeed in ~2-20ms. Gateway /v1/checkout p95 ~2406ms matches the ~2s timeouts.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not admitted; whether payment is slow or unreachable is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment POST /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout transport errors propagating to order and gateway 502s, with inventory/redis healthy. Gateway checkout p95 ~2406ms aligns with ~2s timeouts. Bounded candidate: downstream latency at payment.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Payment service logs or traces showing server-side processing time
Order service metrics to rule out order-side saturation
